correctness.rationale: The quotient relation is closed and the sheet shift is well defined. Proximality to the collapsed fixed point gives M0-shadowing by the source lemma, while the averaged base measure has full support. Mixing supplies hits in every sufficiently large admissible congruence class, giving the exact gcd power law. On each sheet the m-step return is conjugate to a mixing E-system, so any equicontinuous generic factor is constant on that sheet; equivariance therefore makes every such factor a quotient of the m-cycle. The fixed point forbids an ordinary factor onto a fixed-point-free cycle, and the source positive-alpha theorem rules out M_alpha for alpha>0.

value.rationale: The theorem turns a single two-sheet sharpness example into a complete family realizing every finite cyclic generic obstruction and simultaneously determines all transitive powers. That gives concrete structure at the exact lower-density endpoint and separates generic from ordinary equicontinuous factors.
residual_risks: The m-sheet extension is elementary enough that an unindexed folklore observation may exist.

final_claim: For every m at least two, the cyclic m-sheet wedge over the proximal mixing base is an E-system with M0-shadowing whose maximal equicontinuous generic factor is the m-cycle, not an ordinary factor; its r-th power is transitive exactly when gcd(r,m)=1, so it is not weakly mixing and has no positive-parameter M_alpha-shadowing.
limitations: Finite cyclic sheet permutations over the specified base only; noncyclic finite factors and a classification of all M0 endpoint systems are not claimed.
